data.long_meaning: The Magyar name Karoly is derived from the Turkic name Kar, which means 'man, free man'. In Hungarian history, Karoly Róbert (1288–1342) was a Hungarian monarch and founder of the Anjou dynasty. The name is popular in Hungary and has a rich cultural heritage. The name Karoly carries the meaning “Man, free man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hungarian. Parents who choose Karoly usually hope their child will grow to embody man, free man and live with faith, good character and purpose.
